system_prompt: You are assisting with a factual question about Thai law. State which provision applies and what it requires. Answer in English.
prompt: In June 2025, did the Thai Labour Protection Act as then in force give employees the right to leave to assist a spouse who had given birth? Answer briefly.
raw_response: As of my knowledge cutoff in October 2023, Section 33/1 of the Thai Labour Protection Act (amended in 2019) grants employees the right to take up to 3 days of paid leave to assist their lawful spouse who has given birth. If this provision remains unchanged by June 2025, it would still apply.
